# typesilk

> A free typing test for the browser. The words glide under a still caret on a spring, keystrokes are recorded sounds, and a coach builds runs around your weakest keys. It needs a physical keyboard and no account.

The app is at the root URL. The text pages below describe it in English and German. The source code is MIT licensed. A longer version of this file is at https://typesilk.com/llms-full.txt.

## Pages

- [Typing test](https://typesilk.com/): The test itself. Runs in the browser and stores results there.
- [About typesilk](https://typesilk.com/about): Modes, results, languages and common questions.
- [Daily leaderboard](https://typesilk.com/daily): The fastest typists on today's shared 40 words.
- [Tipptest auf Deutsch](https://typesilk.com/de): The same information in German, with a link that starts the test with German words.

## Project

- [Source code](https://github.com/jx-grxf/typesilk): MIT licensed, TypeScript and Vite with no UI framework.
- [Releases](https://github.com/jx-grxf/typesilk/releases): Version history.
- [Author](https://johannesgrof.me): Johannes Grof.
